items.en: US Payrolls Unexpectedly Fall 23,000 in July; Stocks Rally to Record on Fed Relief
items.zh: 7 月非農意外減少 2.3 萬人，美股反而創新高
items.summary: US nonfarm payrolls contracted by 23,000 in July, the first drop in months and far below the 83,000 gain Wall Street expected. Government employment fell 53,000 while private payrolls rose just 30,000. The unemployment rate edged down to 4.1%, but only because the labour force participation rate slid to 61.4%, its lowest in over five years. Average hourly earnings growth cooled to 3.2% year on year, the weakest since May 2021. Traders read the weakness as removing any near-term case for a Fed rate hike, and the S&P 500 closed at a record 7,757.64.

items.en: Typhoon Dolphin Makes Closest Approach to Taiwan; Land Warning Possible for Northern Coast
items.zh: 白海豚颱風今日最接近台灣，北海岸恐發陸警
items.summary: Typhoon Dolphin, the season's thirteenth storm, is crawling west-northwest at about 11 kilometres per hour and passes closest to Taiwan on Saturday. The Central Weather Administration issued a sea warning on Friday afternoon and the central emergency response centre is open at level two. Forecasters say rainfall peaks Saturday, with the fiercest wind and rain from Saturday evening through Sunday morning. Northern mountain areas could accumulate 350 to 500 millimetres. Matsu is almost certain to get a land warning, and Keelung's north coast and parts of New Taipei may follow if the track shifts south.
items.source: 中央氣象署 / 今周刊

items.en: Uganda's Parliament Approves Troop Deployment to Gaza Under Trump's Board of Peace
items.zh: 烏干達國會通過派兵加薩，加入川普「和平委員會」國際部隊
items.summary: Uganda's parliament approved deploying troops to Gaza as part of the international stabilisation force proposed by President Trump's Board of Peace, after Trump personally contacted President Yoweri Museveni in July. Morocco has also pledged forces for the mission, which is meant to secure the territory after Israel's war with Hamas. The deployment is politically sensitive in Kampala, where opposition lawmakers questioned both the cost and the legal mandate. Diplomats say troop contributions are the easier half of the problem; the harder question remains who disarms Hamas and in what order.

items.en: Gaza Disarmament Deal Strains as Netanyahu Insists Hamas Disarm First
items.zh: 加薩繳械協議生變，尼坦雅胡堅持哈瑪斯須先全面繳械
items.summary: The days-old agreement brokered by Washington, under which Hamas disarms while Israel halts strikes and withdraws from much of Gaza, is already under strain. Netanyahu said this week that Hamas must completely disarm before any Israeli withdrawal begins, while Israel ordered new mass evacuations in northern Gaza ahead of a possible expansion of operations. Mediators say the sequencing of weapons handovers is the central sticking point, with neither side willing to move first. Israeli officials are reported to be weighing a resumption of strikes if the timetable slips further.

items.en: Saudi Arabia Braces for Port and Airport Attacks as Iran Warns Gulf States
items.zh: 伊朗警告波灣國家，沙烏地嚴防港口機場遭襲
items.summary: Saudi Arabia is preparing for attacks on its ports and airports by Iraqi militias working alongside Iran-backed Houthis, as Tehran warns Gulf states to press Washington to back down or face Iranian retaliation. The standoff has kept a risk premium in crude, with Brent having jumped nearly four percent earlier in the week on Strait of Hormuz shipping fears. US officials say the campaign against Iran has drawn down munitions stockpiles, a claim President Trump publicly disputed. Talks remain stalled, with Tehran continuing to deny that direct negotiations are underway.

items.en: Anthropic Builds an In-House Chip Team to Run Claude Faster
items.zh: Anthropic 自建晶片團隊，要讓 Claude 跑得更快
items.summary: Anthropic is assembling an internal silicon team aimed at squeezing more inference throughput out of the hardware that serves Claude, a move that mirrors what OpenAI and Google have already done. The company has separately committed to multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity through Google and Broadcom, with deliveries expected from 2027. The logic is straightforward: at frontier scale, inference cost is the binding constraint on both margin and price, and custom silicon is the only lever that compounds. It also reduces exposure to Nvidia allocation, which has become the industry's real bottleneck.

items.en: SK Hynix Board Approves ₩54.3 Trillion for Two New Memory Fabs Through 2031
items.zh: SK 海力士董事會通過 54.3 兆韓元，2031 年前蓋兩座記憶體新廠
items.summary: SK Hynix said its board approved roughly 54.3 trillion won, about 38.3 billion dollars, of investment through 2031 to build two new memory chip fabrication plants. The spending is part of a broader expansion of the company's domestic semiconductor production base and is squarely aimed at HBM and AI-server memory demand. The announcement lands in the same week that memory names sold off hard on weak storage guidance, underlining the gap between short-term inventory digestion and the multi-year capacity race. For Taiwan supply chain names, more Korean capacity cuts both ways.

items.en: Samsung Unveils zHBM, Claiming Eight Times the Performance of HBM5
items.zh: 三星發表次世代 zHBM，宣稱效能是 HBM5 的八倍
items.summary: Samsung Electronics revealed a next-generation memory it calls zHBM, claiming roughly eight times the performance of HBM5. If the figure survives contact with real workloads it would reset the bandwidth ceiling for AI accelerators, where memory rather than compute has increasingly been the limiter. The claim arrives alongside AMD's acquisition of inference startup Taalas and Intel's 14.2 billion dollar European fab commitment, all pointing the same direction: the 2026 competitive battleground is memory bandwidth and packaging, not raw transistor count.

items.en: Summer Koshien Continues as Tokai University Kofu Meets Tsuruoka Higashi
items.zh: 夏之甲子園開打，東海大甲府對戰鶴岡東
items.summary: The summer national high school baseball championship at Koshien is in full swing, with Friday's card featuring Tokai University Kofu against Tsuruoka Higashi and continued attention on Seirei's ace Takabe Riku. Japanese sports media are also tracking Sato Teruaki's performances. The tournament runs through late August and remains the most-watched amateur sporting event in Japan, drawing scouts from all twelve NPB clubs. For Taiwanese fans, Koshien is the traditional August substitute while CPBL sits in its midsummer stretch.
items.source: スポーツナビ / バーチャル高校野球

items.en: Premier League 2026-27 Fixtures Released; Arsenal Open at Home to Coventry on August 21
items.zh: 英超 2026-27 賽程出爐，阿森納 8/21 主場迎戰考文垂
items.summary: The Premier League released its 2026-27 fixture list, with reigning champions Arsenal opening at home against promoted Coventry City on Friday, August 21. The season structure keeps the traditional Boxing Day programme and a compressed run around the expanded international calendar. Broadcasters have confirmed the usual Friday-night and Sunday-afternoon slots for the opening weekend. For viewers in Taiwan the opener falls late on a Friday evening local time, roughly two weeks after this weekend's typhoon passes.

items.en: Tyler Mahle Debuts for the Braves at Yankee Stadium as MLB Runs Doubleheaders
items.zh: MLB 雙重賽日，馬勒披勇士戰袍在洋基球場先發初登板
items.summary: Tyler Mahle made his Atlanta Braves debut in Friday night's series opener at Yankee Stadium, headlining a schedule that also included twi-night doubleheaders carried by both Apple TV and MLB Network. The league is deep into its August stretch with playoff positioning tightening. Elsewhere, the 2026 Little League World Series begins August 19 and runs through August 30, and Ohtani Shohei remains the central storyline heading toward Taiwan's Pool C World Baseball Classic meeting with Japan next March.

items.en: Study of 26,000 Students Finds AI Lifts Homework Scores but Sinks Exam Results
items.zh: 2.6 萬名學生研究：AI 讓作業分數上升，考試成績反而下滑
items.summary: A large study of about 26,000 students found homework scores rose 18 percent and completion time fell roughly 30 percent among AI users, but the same students' closed-book exam scores dropped 20 percent within six months, with entrance exam results falling 18 to 24 percent after about two years of use. Roughly 80 percent of student users showed the signature of outsourced thinking: fast, high-scoring homework paired with underperformance once the tool was removed. Nearly half of interactions were purely directive, which the authors classify as automation rather than augmentation.

items.en: Overreliance on AI Leaves Students Less Confident and More Distressed
items.zh: 過度依賴 AI 讓學生更沒自信、也更焦慮
items.summary: Research summarised by the British Psychological Society finds that students who lean more heavily on AI tools report lower self-efficacy, and that this reduced confidence is in turn linked to higher burnout and anxiety. The mechanism matters more than the headline: it is not the tool itself but the loss of the struggle phase, where difficulty and recovery build the belief that one can cope. The practical implication for university students is to use AI after attempting a problem rather than instead of attempting it, preserving the effortful retrieval that both learning and confidence depend on.

items.en: NPR/Ipsos Poll: Teachers Save Time With AI but Fear Students Are Losing the Habit of Thinking
items.zh: NPR/Ipsos 民調：老師靠 AI 省時，卻擔心學生不再自己思考
items.summary: A new NPR and Ipsos poll shows many teachers now use AI to cut preparation and grading time, while a majority simultaneously worry the technology is making it harder for students to learn to think independently. The split captures the central tension in education policy this year: the productivity case for teachers is clear and immediate, whereas the cognitive cost to students is delayed and hard to measure until exam season. Fortune separately reported that US math and reading scores fell after schools shifted from textbooks to screens.

items.en: Claude Opus 5 Holds the Intelligence Index Lead at Half of Fable 5's Price
items.zh: Claude Opus 5 續居智慧指數第一，價格只有 Fable 5 的一半
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5, released on July 24, continues to lead Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index with a score of 61, priced at five dollars per million input tokens and twenty-five per million output, roughly half the cost of Claude Fable 5. It is Anthropic's fourth model in under two months after Mythos 5 and Fable 5. The pricing is read as an attempt to hold the frontier-quality tier while Chinese labs undercut Western list prices from below. Anthropic is now also building an in-house chip team to lower serving costs further.

items.en: OpenAI Pushes Toward ChatGPT 6 While Gemini 3.5 Pro Slips Behind Schedule
items.zh: OpenAI 推進 ChatGPT 6，Gemini 3.5 Pro 進度落後
items.summary: OpenAI is targeting a ChatGPT 6 release in late summer 2026, though internal testing has surfaced cybersecurity vulnerabilities significant enough to prompt discussions with US officials. OpenAI also cut API prices on its two cheaper GPT-5.6 tiers on July 30, with Luna down 80 percent and Terra down 20 percent. Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro remains unreleased; Bloomberg reported on July 16 that it is months behind schedule and short of internal goals, particularly on coding. Both Anthropic and OpenAI are voluntarily complying with a US programme controlling frontier-model access.

items.en: Custom Silicon Race Accelerates: OpenAI-Broadcom Accelerator, Google Bakes Gemini Into Hardware
items.zh: 自研晶片競賽加速：OpenAI 攜博通推推論加速器，Google 把 Gemini 燒進硬體
items.summary: OpenAI unveiled an inference accelerator co-designed with Broadcom in June, describing a nine-month path from first design to tape-out, an unusually short cycle for high-performance silicon. Google has gone further with an experimental design that bakes part of Gemini's structure directly into the hardware. Meanwhile AI coding agents are eroding Nvidia's software moat: startup Infinity used them to recreate CUDA-like tooling for chip startup D-Matrix in roughly ten hours. SpaceX, by contrast, is committing exclusively to Nvidia hardware for ground and orbital AI data centres.

items.en: CORRECTION: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour Hong Kong Date Is Cancelled; Kaohsiung Still On for October 31
items.zh: ★【更正】藤井風 Prema 香港站已取消，高雄 10/31 場次照常
items.summary: An important correction to yesterday's brief: the Hong Kong stop of Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour has been cancelled, with ticketing site Timable listing the date as cancelled and Hong Kong media reporting the announcement came without warning. The Kaohsiung show remains confirmed for October 31 at the National Stadium, the tour's first overseas stop, with roughly 40,000 seats and tickets that went on sale June 20 through KKTIX and FamiPort. Japanese dates stand at Fukuoka November 14 to 15, Osaka December 10 and 12 to 13, and Tokyo December 19 to 20.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu Announces 2026 TOUR / GHOST: Six Cities, Fourteen Shows From November
items.zh: 米津玄師公布 2026 TOUR / GHOST：6 城 14 場，11 月開跑
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu announced his 2026 TOUR / GHOST arena run on May 27, covering six locations and fourteen performances beginning in November 2026. He released his fifteenth single, Plazma / BOW AND ARROW, on June 11. No Taiwan, Hong Kong or other overseas legs have been announced for this cycle, so the practical route for fans outside Japan is a domestic arena date. Given how his previous tours sold, lottery registration rather than general sale is the realistic entry point, and those windows typically open two to three months ahead.

items.en: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026: First Centre-Stage Production Across 15 Cities and 29 Shows
items.zh: King Gnu CEN+RAL Tour 2026：首度中央舞台，15 城 29 場
items.summary: King Gnu announced the CEN+RAL Tour 2026, the band's first production built around a centre stage, spanning fifteen cities and twenty-nine performances from February 2026. The staging change is the headline: a centre-stage configuration roughly doubles usable sightlines and lets the band sell seats behind the performance area, which is why the show count is unusually high for a Japanese arena run. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates are attached to this leg, though the band has historically added Asian shows after the domestic run concludes.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Sixth Album Lands September 30 With First Arena Tour in Three Years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯 9/30 發行，三年來首場巡迴同步啟動
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on September 30, paired with their first arena tour in three years. The band has been running a sixteen-date live schedule through the summer including Nippon Budokan and Ariake Arena, and is fronting the CEREMONY project. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates have been announced for this cycle. The realistic options remain chasing a Japan date or waiting for a possible Asia leg announcement after the album lands at the end of September.

items.en: YOASOBI Wraps Its Largest North American Run at the Hollywood Bowl
items.zh: YOASOBI 史上最大北美巡迴，終站好萊塢露天劇場
items.summary: YOASOBI's NEVER ENDING STORIES tour is the duo's biggest North American run to date, combining six headline shows with festival appearances at OSHEAGA and Lollapalooza across eight dates, closing at the Hollywood Bowl. Attention among Asian fans has shifted to the rumoured Kai Tak Stadium show in Hong Kong, which local media flagged as a possible concern following the Fujii Kaze cancellation. Nothing official has changed on the YOASOBI side, so treat that as speculation rather than news until the promoter confirms.

market.note: 美股 8/7 上演「壞消息就是好消息」。7 月非農意外減少 2.3 萬人（市場原估 +8.3 萬）、政府部門減 5.3 萬、勞動參與率跌到 61.4%（逾五年新低）、時薪年增放緩到 3.2%（2021 年 5 月以來最低）。數據一出，市場直接把「Fed 短期升息」這個選項刪掉，資金全面回補利率敏感的科技與長天期成長股：S&P 500 上漲 0.62% 收 7,757.64 創歷史收盤新高、那斯達克大漲 1.30% 收 26,690.62、道瓊漲 151.83 點（+0.28%）收 54,036.93 同創新高。Atlassian（TEAM）財報後狂飆 35% 是當日最大亮點，前一天被砍的記憶體與晶片股全面回補。單週來看 S&P +3.6%、那斯達克 +5.2%、道瓊近 +3%，連兩週收紅。台股 8/7 則是收黑作收：加權指數下跌 170.79 點、收 44,225.91（-0.38%），早盤一度衝到 44,827.13，隨後 AI 權值股賣壓出籠震盪走低，成交 8,444.40 億元，仍守住月線與季線；櫃買指數重挫 1.83% 收 384.19。今天週六台股休市，美股這根長紅棒要等下週一才會反映——但同時要注意白海豚颱風對週一開盤情緒的影響。

market.disclaimer: 8/7 兩個市場的方向完全相反，這件事本身就是重點。台股 8/7 白天在殺記憶體、被動元件與矽晶圓，晚上美股卻因為一份很爛的就業報告全面噴出、S&P 與道瓊雙雙創新高、那斯達克大漲 1.3%，前一天被砍的晶片股全數收復。也就是說台股是「拿不到美股最新資訊就先賣」，而週末休市讓這個時間差整整拉長兩天。下週一（8/10）台股開盤要同時消化三件事：① 美股 8/7 的大漲與晶片股回補；② 白海豚颱風對交通、供電與市場情緒的實際影響；③ 0050 與 0056 當天配息入帳。要留意的是，非農轉負代表的是「Fed 不會升息」，但同時也代表「美國經濟真的在降溫」——市場現在只交易前半句，後半句通常會遲到一到兩個月才反映在財報上。本區塊僅為資訊整理，非投資建議。
